Please provide us with the following information for us to be able to process your request as soon as possible • Trial balance (TB) for the submitted return extracted from the system in PDF format which contains: beginning balances, movement, and ending balance for the return period • Trial balance (TB) for the submitted return in MS Excel format which contains: beginning balances, movement, and ending balance for the return period • Bank account statements (for all bank accounts) for the submitted return • Detailed sales listing for the submitted return in MS Excel format with break down into standard rated, zero rated and exempt • Detailed listing for standard rated purchases for the submitted return in MS Excel format Best regards, GAZT For more information, please call 19993. Or visit GAZT website: www.gazt.gov.sa Should we require further information, we would be in contact.
